# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of SwiftX seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability, we appreciate
your help in disclosing it to us in a responsible manner.

To report a security vulnerability, please follow these steps:

1. Visit our [Security Page](https://github.com/RetroHazard/SwiftX/security) on GitHub.
2. Click on the "Report a vulnerability" button.
3. Provide a detailed description of the vulnerability, including steps to reproduce if possible.
4. Allow us a reasonable amount of time to address and mitigate the issue before disclosing it publicly.

Please do not report vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

This policy covers SwiftX itself (the macOS app under `ShareX.macOS/`). SwiftX is an independent
project and is not affiliated with the ShareX Team — vulnerabilities specific to the original
Windows ShareX application should be reported to [ShareX/ShareX](https://github.com/ShareX/ShareX/security)
instead.

We encourage you to play a crucial role in keeping our project secure, and we thank you for your contributions to the community.

Thank you for your cooperation.
